description_full:
Want to turn your degree into a real career? 🎓
Aurora Executive Placement Consultant is opening a Recruitment Consultant Internship in Kelapa Gading, North Jakarta.

Learn how recruitment really works, from sourcing to interviews, and get hands-on experience in the industry.

📩 Send your CV to career@auroraepc.com, cc resume@auroraepc.com

[poster text]
Kelapa Gading, North Jakarta
AURORA
RECRUITMENT CONSULTANT INTERN
EXECUTIVE
PLACEMENT
Industry : Recruitment industry
CONSULTANT
What You'll Do & Learn
Source potential candidates through LinkedIn and other
recruitment platforms, and review CVs against job requirements.
Communicate with candidates and assist with initial screening.
Coordinate interviews, manage candidate follow-ups, and maintain
candidate databases.
Support recruitment reporting and administrative tasks throughout
the hiring process.
Who We're Looking For
Final-year or active university students majoring in Psychology,
Human Resources, Business, or related fields; internship program
participants are welcome.
Have a strong interest in recruitment, talent acquisition, and
human resources.
Possess good communication and interpersonal skills; organized,
detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.
Available to work on-site in Kelapa Gading, North Jakarta.
Send your cv to:
career@auroraepc.com
cc to resume@auroraepc.com
